# Introducing Cricut EasyPress Mini™ – 6 x 3


-
-
-


16 October 2026


[Cricut](https://cricut.com/blog/author/cricut/)


---


Meet Cricut EasyPress Mini™ – 6 x 3, a compact, handheld heat press designed to make pressing feel simple while delivering polished results.


Combining Cricut’s proven edge-to-edge heat with the familiar comfort and control of a household iron, this new mini heat press gives makers a convenient way to tackle small-to-medium heat transfer projects.


The ergonomic handle and precision tip make it easy to maneuver around iron-on details and hard-to-reach areas. The 6 in x 3 in heat plate provides enough coverage for projects like backpacks, totes, small T-shirts, and more.


## More coverage without giving up control


The Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 strikes a balance between coverage and precision. The 6 in x 3 in heat plate gives you more surface area than other small handheld heat presses while still being lightweight and portable.


The ergonomic handle provides comfortable control as you move across your project. And the precision tip allows for greater visibility when you’re working around pockets, seams, zippers, or other details.


The result is a small but mighty heat press that can handle a variety of projects while remaining portable.


## Even heat for confident, long-lasting transfers


One of the biggest differences between a household iron and a dedicated handheld heat press is heat consistency.


Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 is designed to deliver even, edge-to-edge heat consistently across the plate to help you achieve long-lasting transfers. Unlike a traditional household iron, which may have steam holes and inconsistent heat spots, a Cricut® heat press provides a surface designed specifically for heat-transfer applications.


## Designed to feel familiar and easy


If you’ve ever used an iron, Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 will feel familiar because of the ergonomic handle, but it comes packed with the consistency of a powerful heat press.


Three built-in heat settings make it easy to select the right temperature for your project. And when you need more specific guidance, the online Cricut Heat Guide provides step-by-step recommendations for temperature, pressing time, compatible heat-transfer materials, and blanks.


For makers just learning how to use a mini heat press, the experience is simple:


1. Check the recommended settings for your materials in the interactive[Cricut Heat Guide](https://cricut.com/heatguide)
2. Prepare your project blank and position your design
3. Use Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 to apply even heat across the design


## What can you make with Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3?


The compact size of Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 makes it especially useful for smaller designs when a larger heat press is too big.


Use it for projects like:


- Backpacks
- Totes and bags
- Small-to-medium T-shirts and apparel
- Small-to-medium heat-transfer designs
- Adding details to areas around pockets, seams, and zippers


For larger designs, frequent production, or batch making, a larger heat press, like Cricut EasyPress® SE or Cricut AutoPress™ 2, provides greater coverage and efficiency.


## Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 vs other Cricut heat presses


Every Cricut heat press is designed to support different kinds of making. Here’s how Cricut EasyPress Mini — 6 x 3 fits into the lineup:

Heat plate size 6 in x 3 in 3 in x 2 in – 9 in x 9 in
– 12 in x 10 in – 12 in x 12 in
– 15 in x 15 in


Portability Highly portable Highly portable Portable Dedicated workspace required


Manual control ✓ ✓ ✓ Automatic pressing


Best suited for Small-to-medium projects and detailed areas Small projects and tight spaces Larger everyday heat-transfer projects Larger designs, batch making, and frequent use


## Is a mini heat press better than an iron?


For heat transfer projects, a dedicated mini heat press offers several advantages over a household iron.


A household iron is designed primarily for smoothing and pressing clothing, and the heating surface may have spots that are different temperatures. A Cricut heat press, on the other hand, is designed specifically to apply even, edge-to-edge heat to transfer materials.


Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 provides:


- Dry, edge-to-edge heat designed for heat transfer projects
- Consistent heating across the entire pressing surface
- Greater visibility and control to work around detailed areas
- Three built-in heat settings
- A compact design that’s easy to store and transport


For makers who want the familiar feel of an iron but the consistency of a heat press, Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 brings the two experiences together for polished results every time you press.


## Sublimation and Infusible Ink® with a mini heat press


Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 can be used with compatible[sublimation and Infusible Ink](https://cricut.com/blog/sublimation-and-infusible-ink-with-cricut/) materials.


The consistent, edge-to-edge heat at these necessary higher temperatures helps support successful design transfers on compatible blanks using recommended settings.


For the most reliable results, always check heat press temperature guide and application instructions in the[Cricut Heat Guide](https://cricut.com/en-us/heatguide) before pressing. Recommended temperature and pressing time can vary depending on the material and blank you’re using.


## Where to buy Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3


Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 is available in[Powder Blue](https://cricut.com/en-us/heat-presses/cricut-easypress-mini/easypress-mini-6-x-3/cricut-easypress-mini---6-x-3-powder-blue/2013493.html) and[Lavender](https://cricut.com/en-us/heat-presses/cricut-easypress-mini/easypress-mini-6-x-3/cricut-easypress-mini---6-x-3-lavender/2013495.html) at cricut.com and major retailers that carry Cricut products.


When choosing where to purchase Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3, check the product listing to confirm the exact size, potential bundle contents, and included accessories.


## Frequently Asked Questions


####


Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 is a compact, handheld heat press that combines consistent, edge-to-edge heat settings with the control and portability of an iron. The 6 in x 3 in heat plate provides adequate coverage while maintaining a compact size and visibility of your project while you press. It’s great for pressing small-to-medium designs on blanks like apparel, decor, totes, and more, where a larger heat press may be more than you need.


####


Yes. Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 delivers more reliable results than a household iron and was created specifically for heat-transfer projects with consistent, edge-to-edge heat. Unlike many household irons, which can have hot and cool spots or steam holes, Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 delivers an even heating surface designed for applying HTV.


####


Can Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 be used for shirts?


Yes. Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 works well for applying HTV and other compatible heat-transfer materials to shirts, especially small-to-medium designs. For larger shirt designs or batch making, Cricut EasyPress SE or Cricut AutoPress 2 heat presses may be more efficient.


####


Yes. Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 can be used with compatible sublimation and Infusible Ink materials. The consistent, edge-to-edge heat at requisite higher temperatures helps ensure successful transfers when used with compatible blanks and recommended heat settings. Always follow the recommended time, temperature, and application instructions for your specific material and project in[Cricut Heat Guide](https://cricut.com/heatguide) .


####


No. Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 does not connect to Design Space and does not require an app to operate. You can use the interactive[Cricut Heat Guide](https://cricut.com/heatguide) to find the recommended settings and application instructions for your project.


####


Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 is a handheld heat press that requires manual pressure and is portable, easy to store, and ideal for smaller projects. Cricut AutoPress 2 is a large, automatic heat press that requires a dedicated workspace and is available in 12 in x 12 in and 15 in x 15 in sizes. Cricut AutoPress 2 automates the pressing process and provides consistent pressure, making it better suited for larger designs, batch making, frequent use, and small businesses.
